item.description: Lecture notes on standard 1st and 2nd order system responses.

item.description: Lecture notes on root locus development.

item.description: Lecture notes on root locus sketching rules, root locus refinement, and MATLAB root locus functions.

item.description: Lecture notes on sinusoidal system response.

item.description: Lecture notes on sinusoidal frequency response and pole-zero plots.

item.description: Lecture notes on frequency response and the pole-zero plot, phase response, behavior in the proximity of poles and zeros close to the imaginary axis, logarithmic (Bode) plots, and logarithmic amplitude and frequency scales.

item.description: Lecture notes on transfer functions and loop/mesh currents.
